svg.title: PMO portfolio runtime: protected commitments, scoped priority policy and three agents
svg.desc: The UI reads saved recommendations and starts a fresh review. The API validates progress, applies project over portfolio over global priority weights, and checks recommendation eligibility and duplicates. Three read-only Foundry agents use Bing and private APIM OneLake tools. The full register is available for duplicate checks, but only not-started projects can be prioritized. OneLake stores model evidence, pending projects, progress, weights, decisions and report snapshots.
svg.text: PMO Portfolio Prioritization | Current runtime architecture
New / not-started recommendations. Started work stays protected. People approve every action.
Ionic Angular application | Web, tablet and mobile
Portfolio views and six explained charts | Intake and dropdown creation | Project start / finish / completion
Saved report loads first; a fresh review starts on page entry. Admin edits global, portfolio and project priority weights.
Browser API requests
FastAPI backend | Validation, governance and saved-analysis scoring
Project override > portfolio override > global defaults | 40% saved probability score + 60% field score, with rule floors
Not-started eligibility + duplicate checks | Validated dates + revision conflicts | Human-approved conditional writes
State-aware report cache: policy + portfolio + question + current project/progress/weight state. No invented replacement scores.
Managed identity / pinned agent versions
